pairs: Et clamavit in auribus meis voce magna,
And he cried out in my ears with a loud voice,
“The visitations of the city have drawn near,
et unusquisque vas interfectionis habet in manu sua.
and each one has equipment for killing in his hand.”
Et ecce sex viri veniebant de via portæ superioris,
And behold, six men were approaching from the way of the upper gate,
et uniuscujusque vas interitus in manu ejus:
And each one had equipment for killing in his hand.
vir quoque unus in medio eorum vestitus erat lineis,
Also, one man in their midst was clothed with linen,
et atramentarium scriptoris ad renes ejus:
and an instrument for writing was at his waist.
et ingressi sunt, et steterunt juxta altare æreum.
And they entered and stood beside the bronze altar.
Et gloria Domini Israël assumpta est de cherub,
And the glory of the Lord of Israel was taken up,
quæ erat super eum ad limen domus:
from the cherub upon which he was,
et vocavit virum qui indutus erat lineis,
to the threshold of the house.
et atramentarium scriptoris habebat in lumbis suis:
And he called out to the man who was clothed with linen and had an instrument for writing at his waist.
And the Lord said to him:
“Cross through the middle of the city,
et signa thau super frontes virorum gementium
and seal a Tau upon the foreheads of the grieving men,
et dolentium super cunctis abominationibus quæ fiunt in medio ejus.
who are mourning over all the abominations which are being committed in its midst.”
And he said to the others,
Your eye shall not be lenient,
and you shall not take pity.
even to utter destruction, old men,
parvulum et mulieres interficite usque ad internecionem:
young men, and virgins, little ones,
omnem autem super quem videritis thau,
and women. But all upon whom you see the Tau,
And begin from my sanctuary.” Therefore,
they began with the men among the elders,
who were before the face of the house.
and fill its courts with the slain!
et percutiebant eos qui erant in civitate.
and struck down those who were in the city.
And when the slaughter was completed,
I remained. And I fell upon my face,
Will you now destroy the entire remnant of Israel,
by pouring out your fury upon Jerusalem?”
Iniquitas domus Israël et Juda magna est nimis valde,
“The iniquity of the house of Israel, and of Judah, is vast and exceedingly great,
and the land has been filled with blood,
and the city has been filled with what is abhorrent.
my eye will not be lenient,
and I will not take pity.
viam eorum super caput eorum reddam.
I will repay their own way upon their head.”
Et ecce vir qui erat indutus lineis,
And behold, the man who was clothed with linen,
qui habebat atramentarium in dorso suo,
who had a writing instrument at his back,
“I have done just as you instructed me.”
